Cover line 2 (the <=$50 aggregate) is a bare dash on all three columns, so there is no line-1/line-2 residual. No row is labelled in-kind; the monetary-only convention closes exactly, and since no row carries an in-kind tag the in-kind-inclusive convention yields the identical figure.

expenditures.detail: 18 Form B rows on p3 sum to 6,948.22 = the schedule's printed total = the cover's line-3 This-Report cell = its Cumulative cell. Cross-check: the cover's line-4 Ending Balance is printed in accounting parentheses as (718.22), and 6,230.00 - 6,948.22 = -718.22, so the filer's own three printed figures are internally consistent. NOTE the read that got there: on the 200 dpi full-page pass row 4 (4/6/2014 Wright Signs, Signs) read as 70.39 and the 18 rows then summed to 6,248.22 — exactly 700.00 short of the printed total. The arithmetic gate was treated as governing (GOTCHAS: arithmetic closure outranks glyph reading), the amount column was re-cropped at 700 dpi, and the cell reads $770.39: a leading 7 lost to the downsample, not a filer error. With 770.39 the 18 rows close exactly. No row is labelled in-kind; monetary-only is the convention that closed.

itemized.notes: INDEPENDENT RE-READ (2026-08-18 close-out leg). The 2026-08-14 record for this key was withdrawn for geometry defects; that quarantined record was NOT opened and no value was carried from it. Every figure was read fresh off the 200 dpi full-page renders and every band was re-measured and crop-proved. This read landed on the same two gate figures the audit named (contributions 6,230.00 on p2, expenditures 6,948.22 over 18 rows on p3), reached independently and only after the arithmetic forced the p3 row-4 escalation described in recon.expenditures.detail. FORM ORDER on this filing is the conventional one: p2 = Form A, p3 = Form B. Typed form; RECEIVED stamp OCT 24 2014; candidate signed 10/24/14 and the committee secretary 10/22/2014. The two schedules use DIFFERENT date shapes and both are kept verbatim: Form A writes M/D/YY (4/5/14), Form B writes M/D/YYYY (3/14/2014). Form B's last three amounts (250.00, 400.00, 1033.28) are printed WITHOUT the dollar sign the other fifteen carry — a filer typography difference, not a different unit. PRIVACY: Form A prints a full street address for every donor; only the city/state component is carried, per PRIVACY.md. Form B has a City column but no state column, so vendor_state is honestly BLANK — left empty BY THE FORM, not redacted by the county. Cover line 2 and the whole 'Totals From Last Report' column are bare dashes: NIL MARKS, left BLANK per the zero-glyph ruling, never 0. The cover's line-4 Ending Balance (718.22) is printed in accounting parentheses and is genuinely negative — the campaign closed this report 718.22 in deficit.
